nodes.name: skill-watcher.ts
nodes.summary: Watches a skill directory on the filesystem and fires a debounced onChange callback whenever Markdown skill files are added, changed, or removed. Provides a close handle to stop the watcher.

nodes.name: watchSkillDirectory
nodes.summary: Sets up a debounced fs.watch on the given directory, queuing changed .md files and flushing them as a batch to the onChange callback after a configurable debounce delay.

nodes.name: smart-router.ts
nodes.summary: Implements a lightweight heuristic message router that selects between a primary model and a cheaper budget model based on message word count, code blocks, URLs, and keyword complexity.

nodes.name: routeMessage
nodes.summary: Analyzes a message string and returns either the primary or budget model id based on heuristic complexity signals (length, code, URLs, complex keywords).

nodes.name: tool-detection.ts
nodes.summary: Detects installed AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, Codex Desktop) on the host system by probing well-known binary paths, environment variables, and hook configuration files in a dependency-injectable, cross-platform manner.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a dependency-injection approach for all I/O (exists, execVersion, readJson, pathFromEnv) so the module is fully testable without touching the real filesystem or spawning processes.

nodes.name: detectInstalledTools
nodes.summary: Orchestrates parallel detection of all 7 supported AI tools by resolving dependencies and fanning out to per-tool detectors, returning a timestamped array of detection results.

nodes.name: tool-process-tracker.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a ToolProcessTracker class that registers, lists, and gracefully kills tracked OS processes (SIGTERM then SIGKILL with a delay), automatically evicting dead PIDs on list.

nodes.name: ToolProcessTracker
nodes.summary: Tracks a set of running OS processes associated with AI tools; supports register, list (with dead-PID auto-eviction), kill (SIGTERM→SIGKILL), forget, size, and clear operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Accepts injectable isAlive, sendSignal, and delay functions for hermetic unit testing without spawning real processes.

nodes.name: auto-identity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the auto-identity module, verifying that ensureIdentity correctly detects and initialises identity state.

nodes.name: compliance-pdf.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the compliance-pdf module, covering buildComplianceDocDefinition, renderComplianceReportPdf, and writeComplianceReportPdf with fixture report data.

nodes.name: credential-pool.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for CredentialPool, covering credential acquisition, rate-limit enforcement, vault loading via loadCredentialPool, and status-code extraction.

nodes.name: cron-delivery-router.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the cron delivery router, verifying deliverCronResult dispatching to connectors and createDefaultDeliveryPreferences with various message and connector configurations.

nodes.name: grounding-check.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for grounding-check utilities, verifying extractClaimedSpecifics and checkGrounding correctly detect unsupported factual claims in agent responses.

nodes.name: integration-m3b.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the M3b milestone, exercising agent orchestration and memory retrieval flows end-to-end without external imports.

nodes.name: integration-m3c.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the M3c milestone, validating agent recall and knowledge-graph interaction in end-to-end scenarios.

nodes.name: iteration-budget.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for IterationBudget, verifying budget initialisation, decrement behaviour, exhaustion detection, and reset logic.

nodes.name: model-family.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the model-family module, asserting that familyForModel correctly classifies known model identifiers into their provider/family groupings.

nodes.name: phase-5-monitoring.test.ts
nodes.summary: Extensive unit tests for the canary phase-5 monitoring module, covering all metric emitters (pass-II rate, retrieval engagement, latency, cost, errors) and rollback/alert threshold checks using an in-memory JSONL writer fixture.

nodes.name: quality-controller.test.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal unit tests for checkResponseQuality, verifying that basic quality checks pass or fail for representative agent response strings.

nodes.name: skill-watcher.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration-style tests for watchSkillDirectory, creating real temporary directories and files to verify debounced change detection and watcher close behaviour.

nodes.name: smart-router.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for routeMessage, asserting that short, simple messages route to the budget model and complex/long messages route to the primary model.

nodes.name: tool-detection.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for detectInstalledTools, using injected dependency stubs (makeDeps) to simulate presence or absence of each supported AI tool across platforms without real filesystem access.

nodes.name: tool-process-tracker.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ToolProcessTracker, verifying process registration, listing with dead-PID eviction, graceful kill sequences (SIGTERM/SIGKILL), and tracker lifecycle methods.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the agent package, setting module resolution and strict options and referencing sibling workspace packages as project references.

nodes.name: vitest.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest configuration for the agent package, defining the test include patterns and any environment settings for the package's unit and integration test suite.

nodes.name: waggle.js
nodes.summary: Minimal CLI entry-point shim for the @waggle/cli package; sets the executable bit shebang and delegates immediately to the compiled CLI main module.

nodes.name: real-session-simulation.ts
nodes.summary: End-to-end session simulation script that populates a Waggle orchestrator with identity, awareness, knowledge-graph entities, and memory frames, then performs a cold-start recall test to validate memory retrieval quality.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @waggle/core, declaring its name, version, ESM type, CJS/ESM dual exports, build script, runtime dependencies (better-sqlite3, sqlite-vec, pdfkit, etc.) and dev dependencies.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel entry point for the compliance sub-module of @waggle/core, re-exporting InteractionStore, ComplianceStatusChecker, ReportGenerator, and ComplianceTemplateStore.
